value.rationale: The graph is a canonical quartic monomial hypersurface and its Fourier idempotent norm, full magnitude distribution and support count are natural exact invariants. Cubing induces a sharp bijective versus three-fold arithmetic transition; extension fields produce a genuine two-dimensional trace statistic rather than the one-dimensional statistic over split prime fields. The large-characteristic split norm slope is identified with a nontrivial known three-step random-walk integral. These infinite-family structural effects are not a routine finite computation or an arbitrary parameter slice.
